items.title: DGK.Kardiale Bildgebung 2026
items.summary: In-person congress in Cologne's Sartory Ssäle covering echocardiography, cardiac MRI and cardiac CT.

items.title: 93. DGK-Jahrestagung
items.summary: Annual DGK congress under the motto '100 Jahre DGK Wissen – Innovation – Zukunft', with a junior researcher programme and sessions on several cardiology fields.

items.title: Deutscher Echokardiographie-Kongress (DEK) 2027
items.summary: In-person echocardiography congress offering hands-on user courses, honorary lectures, practice seminars and live demonstrations.

items.title: DGK Herztage 2027
items.summary: Five congresses under one roof at the Congress Centrum Hamburg, including Kardiologie Aktuell, Deutsche Rhythmus Tage, AGIK Live, DGK-Akademie and Basic Science Meeting.
